title: Virtual Compute: assisted review — contract price
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute assisted review — Use the approved negotiated primary unit price when the holding negotiated-price approval is approved; otherwise use its contracted standard unit unit price, with the selected holding required to retain the same tier throughout the target service period.
